_meanings:
having a meaning which is easily understood from
 the context.

a doctrine of the Mīmāṃsakas that
 words in a sentence convey meanings not independently or generally, but
 as connected with one another in that particular sentence; see {#aBihitAnvayavAdin#}
 under {#aBiDA#} and <ls>K. P. 2</ls>.
